objective: Locate the retry setting and report its value.
expected: src/db/config.py defines DB_RETRY_COUNT = 3.

objective: Locate the timeout setting and report its value.
expected: src/db/config.py defines DB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 5.

objective: Locate the session factory definition and describe what it returns.
expected: src/db/session.py defines create_session().
The function returns a dictionary with retries and timeout keys.

objective: Identify how the worker uses the session factory.
expected: src/service/worker.py imports create_session from src.db.session.
run() returns the result of create_session().

objective: Identify how the health check uses the session factory.
expected: src/api/health.py imports create_session from src.db.session.
readiness() assigns create_session() to session before checking timeout.

objective: Find every source call site of create_session() in the fixture, excluding definitions, imports, and comments.
expected: src/service/worker.py:4 calls create_session() inside run().
src/api/health.py:4 calls create_session() inside readiness().
src/db/session.py:3 is a definition and src/service/notes.py:1 is a comment, not additional callers.
A source call site does not establish that it executed.

objective: Explain how the retry and timeout settings reach the session factory's returned dictionary.
expected: src/db/config.py defines DB_RETRY_COUNT and DB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.
src/db/session.py imports both settings from .config.
create_session() maps DB_RETRY_COUNT to retries and DB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS to timeout.

objective: Locate the CLI callable defined in source.
expected: src/cli.py defines main() on line 3.

objective: Explain which worker function the CLI delegates to.
expected: src/cli.py imports run from src.service.worker.
main() returns run().
src/service/worker.py defines that run() function.

objective: Identify the declared command name and its target callable without running or installing it.
expected: pyproject.toml declares fixture-check under [project.scripts].
Its target is src.cli:main.
The declaration alone does not prove successful installation or execution.

objective: Explain the readiness condition from source without claiming the check has run.
expected: src/api/health.py defines readiness().
It obtains session from create_session() and returns whether session["timeout"] is greater than zero.

objective: Follow the README's retry-configuration pointer and verify it against source.
expected: README.md points to src/db/config.py for retry configuration.
src/db/config.py confirms DB_RETRY_COUNT = 3; the documentation pointer alone is not verification.

objective: Determine whether the create_session() mention in service notes is an executable call site.
expected: src/service/notes.py:1 begins with # and contains only a planned-call comment.
It is a text match, not an executable caller.

objective: Check the design note's claim that the database layer creates sessions from configuration.
expected: docs/design.md states that the database layer creates sessions from configuration.
src/db/session.py supports this by importing retry and timeout settings and using them in create_session().
The source creates a dictionary; it does not demonstrate an actual database connection.

objective: Trace the source-level chain from main() to the retry setting and describe the returned data without executing the fixture.
expected: src/cli.py main() returns worker.run().
src/service/worker.py run() returns create_session().
src/db/session.py create_session() returns retries from DB_RETRY_COUNT and timeout from DB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.
src/db/config.py defines those values as 3 and 5 respectively.
This establishes a source-level chain, not evidence that it ran.
